question: Business requirement description: A non-metallic mining company has multiple mines, and each mine has multiple safety officers. The safety officer has information such as safety officer number, name, gender, telephone number, and position. The mine has information such as mine number, name, location, and person in charge. During each safety inspection, it is necessary to record the inspection date, inspection content, inspection results, and inspector information. The information system needs to be able to perform statistical analysis on the safety inspection situation of the mine.
ddl:
--Schemafordatabase:rschema_0071
--Foreachtable:

CREATE TABLE `mines` (
  `mine_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `mine_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `location` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `person_in_charge` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`mine_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `safety_officers` (
  `officer_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `officer_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `gender` char(6) NOT NULL,
  `telephone_number` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `position` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`officer_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `inspections` (
  `inspection_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `mine_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `officer_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `results` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`inspection_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`mine_id`) REFERENCES `mines` (`mine_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`officer_id`) REFERENCES `safety_officers` (`officer_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
